He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, wallet, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

translations.web: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
translations.bsb: Carry no purse or bag or sandals. Do not greet anyone along the road.
translations.kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
translations.asv: Carry no purse, no wallet, no shoes; and salute no man on the way.
